verdict.rationale: Cross-OS and cross-browser use is well documented. The keys work through modern browsers' native PIN prompts, the Windows 10 1903+ control panel, and Chromium's built-in manager on macOS and Linux. Token2 also offers a cross-platform desktop companion, Android/iOS apps and macOS PIV login. The services side is much thinner: only a few integration guides are evidenced (Entra ID, Intune, on-prem AD), and there is no published compatibility catalog of supported services. Missing for 10: a published service compatibility catalog, an explicit browser support matrix, and independent hands-on corroboration of cross-platform behavior.
